notes.title: New Update! Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Adjusted geometry in Secret Level 1 to prevent a softlock.
[*] Fixed a bug where time in the Speedrun Timer would not save properly when entering the Secret Levels.
[*] Adjusted the position of some elements in the Credits Screen.
[*] Added an animation to the movie in the Credits Screen, to prevent the white image issue, similar to the Results Screen.
[*] Game Options "Hit Points" and "Respawn at 0 HP" will now have a red color when the player is in the Main Menu Level.
[*] Deleting your save file from the Delete Save menu will now also remove the Speedrun Timer and Bongo Input Display UI, if they are on screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Walrus Run is available now!
notes.notes:
After 18 months of development, The Jam's first game "Walrus Run" has finally been released! It is a 2D platformer that you can play with conveniently-shaped bongo controllers. But you may have already knew that...

We will be making regular updates to fix bugs and improve quality of life. There are no plans for content updates (such as DLC levels), but we have some things up our sleeve in the future. Stay tuned!

I want to thank everyone for your support the past few months. I am very glad to bring a close to this chapter of my life, and start a new one! I am looking forward to my future endeavors, and to begin development on new games with all the knowledge I've gained.

As a bonus, check the "Bonus" folder of your download and you will find artwork, music, and more, complete with your purchase. Enjoy!

notes.title: Walrus Run Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
We meet again, Walrus Enjoyers!

We are about one month from the launch of Walrus Run - I am very excited and stressed about it!!!

In order to promote the game before launch, Walrus Run is participating in Steam Next Fest. [b]This means a playable demo is available now, on Steam![/b]

Next Fest begins October 14th, but we have released it a tad early so the press can check it out early. That means all of you can play it early too!

We have had some demos in the past, such as our [url=https://the-jam-games.itch.io/walrus-run-sage]SAGE 2024 demo on Itch.io[/url] - while this demo has the same levels, there are plenty of new features. Such features include improved control menu options, game-modifying options are now available, as well as updated visuals, animations, and audio. Not to mention plenty of bug fixes. I will release a YouTube video detailing more changes on October 14th (okay I forgot to talk about the changes, [url=https://youtu.be/CVUHuv-gii8]but the video is here[/url]).

As for what you can do - play the demo, and leave a review! Yes, [b]you can now leave reviews for Steam Demos as of a recent Steam update.[/b] doing so will give us a boost during Next Fest! Oh yeah, and [b]wishlists[/b] will help too...

As I've said before, [b]wishlisting and spreading the word about the game[/b] is the #1 way of supporting the game. Every little bit of help goes a long way!

We are also giving out Pre-Release keys for Content Creators and Press members! You can request a key on our Keymailer page, or fill out this Google Form.

Keymailer: https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/3db9f56b

Google Form: https://forms.gle/N71vxXowZPNM2sGHA


I will of course be updating the demo as needed for any bug fixes. Feel free to leave comments/reviews or [url=https://discord.gg/wUHfrAEbgn]join our Discord[/url] if you wanna give feedback.

I'll also be making regular posts on [url=https://x.com/TheJam_Games]Twitter[/url], and expect some new "video advertisements" on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TheJamGames]our YouTube channel[/url] this month.

And with that.... See you November 5th!

notes.title: Release Date is November 5th! New Trailer! Demos!
notes.notes:
Save the date! The release date for Walrus Run has finally been revealed!

It is my pleasure to announce that Walrus Run will release on Tuesday, November 5th, 2024, at 12 AM EDT!

And with that, we have a new trailer! Featuring updated graphics, cutscene footage, new music, and the release date revealed at the end!

But of course, that's not everything. Walrus Run will have a playable demo available at Supernova 2024!

Supernova, formally known as Super Smash Con, is a large-scale tournament/convention for the Super Smash Bros. and general Nintendo community. Walrus Run has been selected to showcase a demo at Supernova's Indie Game Booth!

Supernova will be located in Chantilly, Virginia, USA, at the Dulles Expo Center, from August 8th to 11th. Visit supersmashcon.com for more details! I can't wait to see you all there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916216/2bf2c090449a5440b0a5daf0003f76fce05b4d2b.png[/img]
Walrus Run will also have a demo at SAGE 2024! SAGE stands for Sonic Amateur Games Expo, and is an online event where game developers can showcase their full games or demos, whether they're fan-games or indie games. Walrus Run's first online, publicly available demo will be at SAGE 2024! Starting September 6th, you can visit sonicfangameshq.com to download Walrus Run's demo.

NOTE: Walrus Run's SAGE page is not currently visible. It will become public when the event starts on September 6th. We will notify the community when it happens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916216/d465f0491a627f4950ec050a1e235b8cdb31e70d.png[/img]

The final announcement is that Walrus Run will be participating in October's Steam Next Fest! Starting October 14th, you can play Walrus Run's demo right off of Steam. At that point we'll only have about a month until launch day!

I wanna thank everyone for their continued support, as I grind away the next 4 months getting this game done. I can't wait for everyone to experience the finished product!

notes.title: Wishlist Walrus Run today!
notes.notes:
[b]The store page for Walrus Run is now live![/b]

My name is Eric Callahan - I am the owner of The Jam Games LLC, and the solo developer for Walrus Run! This game is a 2D Platformer compatible with Bongo-shaped controllers. It is recommended that you use one, but NOT required. You can play the game with modern controllers and keyboard + mouse.

Walrus Run is a score-attack game where you complete 18 linear levels in a short time, with as many points as you an get. The game is relatively easy, but getting S ranks on every level may prove to be a challenge!

If any of this sounds interesting to you, please consider wishlisting the game! Walrus Run releases later this year.
